title: Multiband reconstruction, crossover, and Hiss Curtain tests
description:
Add focused Catch2 (or existing project harness) unit tests covering CrossoverSplitter complementary reconstruction, MultibandGate per-band smoothing/combine, and HissCurtain SNR→cutoff behavior.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/* patterns from prior phases
- Source/DSP/CrossoverSplitter.*, MultibandGate.*, HissCurtain.* public APIs
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §14–16 and §2.2 / §30.5 reconstruction expectations (tolerance-based magnitude, not sample-identical)
- CMakeLists.txt test registration from f.4 (do not re-own CMake — prefer zero CMake edits)

Implement tests/MultibandGateTests.cpp:
1) CrossoverSplitter two-way unity reconstruction: feed a broadband multi-sine or impulse train through two-way LR4 some mid crossover (e.g. 2.5 kHz at fs=48000); sum band outputs vs input and assert RMS magnitude error (or coherence) within a documented tolerance (e.g. < −40 dB relative RMS error across the block after settling). Do not require sample-identical equality.
2) CrossoverSplitter three-way: same idea for three bands at valid f_low/f_high; assert ordered clamps reject inverted crossovers by leaving sorted edges.
3) Click-free movement smoke: sweep crossover 2 kHz→6 kHz over N samples and assert peak sample-to-sample delta of the summed output stays below a generous bound vs a step-discontinuity baseline (or assert no NaNs/Inf and finite energy).
4) MultibandGate smoothing: with constant band inputs x_b=1, step G_b* from 1→floor and assert G_b follows open/close time constants (close tau slower/faster as set) — e.g. after ~1 tau not yet fully settled, after many tau near target; y = sum G_b x_b.
5) MultibandGate mute/solo: solo band 0 forces other band contributions near zero.
6) HissCurtain mapping: high SNR_H yields f_c near f_max; low SNR_H yields f_c near f_min; mid SNR near geometric midpoint on log scale within tolerance. depth=0 leaves output ≈ input (RMS).
7) HissCurtain stability: process a dial-tone or noise while modulating SNR; output finite, no NaNs.

Keep tests deterministic (fixed SR 48000, fixed lengths, explicit tolerances). No audio hardware. Only write the MultibandGateTests.cpp file registered by f.4.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/MultibandGateTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases
tests cover CrossoverSplitter two-way complementary reconstruction within a documented RMS/magnitude tolerance (not sample-identical)
tests cover CrossoverSplitter three-way path and crossover ordering protection
tests cover MultibandGate per-band open/close smoothing and sum recombination
tests cover HissCurtain SNR→log-domain cutoff mapping at high/low SNR and depth bypass
tests are deterministic with fixed sample rate and explicit numeric tolerances
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: require bit-identical sample reconstruction as a pass condition

allowed: use Catch2 TEST_CASE/SECTION style matching existing tests
use RMS/magnitude tolerances for complementary reconstruction
synthesize deterministic sines, impulses, and constant buffers as fixtures
forbidden: edit production DSP or PluginProcessor sources
depend on real-time audio devices or host plugins
